bio: Treat yourself to a contemporary Asian-inspired Afternoon Tea at Inamo Covent Garden and find yourself transported right across the globe.  Inamo Covent Garden takes the quintessential tradition of Afternoon Tea and puts a vibrant, fresh spin on it. Indulge in a mouth-watering array of sushi and Pan-Asian tapas dishes, followed by a sumptuous sweet plate and served alongside your choice of tea. Guests can choose from the tea only option, opt of a glass of Prosecco upon arrival or upgrade to include free-flowing Prosecco for one hour.  Located in the heart of Covent Garden, Inamo finds itself within easy reach of many of London's key attractions. It is just a stone's throw from Covent Garden tube station and just a short walk to Leicester Square tube station.
